critical_code_review_comments: Static Analysis Bridge issues one GET /api/v2/decoded-artifacts/{sha256} per lookup; the 404 (no record) is the correct signal but produces console-noise 404s on every drawer open. Consider suppressing the console log or using a HEAD/exists probe that returns 200 with a boolean payload to keep DevTools quiet for analysts.

The context menu is opened on right-click but there is no keyboard-accessible alternative (context-menu key / Shift+F10 emulation). For SOC accessibility parity with Cisco Secure Endpoint, expose 'edr-ledger-row-actions' or a per-row kebab.

Response action buttons are correctly disabled but the tooltip explanation ('RESPONSE DRIVER NOT REGISTERED …') is only rendered once at the rail header — a per-button title=/aria-describedby would help operators who tab into each control.

Compromise cases table repeats the same 9/7 counts across 5 case_ids (all marked NOT PERSISTED). This is honest, but a single collapsed row 'x5 case references, none persisted' would remove the visually redundant block on high-density endpoints such as ENG-42 (also 5 rows).
seed_data_creation: None. Verified against pre-existing v2_shadow_observations (639 docs, 7 devices) and decoded_artifacts store (169 records — none match FIN-07 hashes, which is the expected honest state).
